scenario: kerberos generic preauth failure, collector unavailable (insufficient evidence)
notes: IPAHostKeytab fails with the generic 'Preauthentication failed' message, but there is deliberately NO kerberos_client.json fixture file in this directory, so collect_replay returns zero items (simulating the collector being unable to run, e.g. permission-denied). Without kvno_comparison data, KeytabKvnoMismatchRule cannot safely distinguish clock skew / keytab mismatch / salt mismatch, so it emits UNKNOWN_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE with next_diagnostic_step telling the admin to run the kvno/klist -kte comparison and check chronyc/date against the KDC by hand. ClockSkewRule and KdcDiscoveryFailureRule both return None (no clock or DNS-style evidence present at all).
